record.question: Mizoram shares its borders with which of the following three states:
record.explanation: Answer A: Assam, Manipur and Tripura. Mizoram borders Assam, Manipur and Tripura, as well as Bangladesh and Myanmar. Reference: https://mizoram.nic.in/about/geography.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
